annotation.title_clean: Arrêté du Gouvernement en Conseil du 25 octobre 2024 déterminant la composition et le fonctionnement du comité interministériel de coordination pour la conduite automatisée
annotation.title_en: Order of the Government in Council of 25 October 2024 determining the composition and functioning of the interministerial coordination committee for automated driving
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Gouvernement en Conseil, Grand-Duché de Luxembourg (Ministère de l'Économie)
annotation.venue: Mémorial A n° 447 de 2024 (Journal officiel du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg)
annotation.summary_en: Luxembourg government order establishing an interministerial coordination committee for automated driving under the Minister of Economy. It sets membership, five-year terms, consensus decision-making and procedures, and tasks the committee with a national strategy and action plan, preparing a regulatory framework and setting up living-lab test environments by Q1 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates an interministerial coordination committee for automated driving under the Minister of Economy
Mission: automated driving strategy, national action plan, preparatory work for a clear, evolving regulatory framework
Establish test environments/living labs during Q1 2025
Six ministry-designated members with alternates, five-year renewable terms, decisions by consensus
Secretariat support and external experts may be consulted
